text:
Before: a grilled cheese sandwich (2 slices of bread, cheese, butter) at about 350 kcal and 110 g. Avocado toast, 2 half slices with avocado, about 250 kcal and 150 g. A cup of milky coffee or tea at about 60 kcal and 200 g, though the drink is a liquid and may not count as food.

After: the grilled cheese is gone. What remains is about 1.5 pieces of avocado toast, mostly crusts and some bread, roughly 30-40% of the avocado toast. The cup has a little liquid left, perhaps a tenth of it.

Eaten: grilled cheese 350 kcal, avocado toast about 65% of 250 = 160 kcal, drink about 55 kcal. Total is about 565 kcal.

Mass: grilled cheese 110 g, avocado toast about 95 g, drink about 180 g. Total is about 385 g.
